item.title: Humane World for Animals: Web Designer, eCRM
item.skills: A/B Testing, AWS, Compliance, Google Analytics, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, MySQL, Node.js, PHP, SASS, UI/UX, UX design, Jira, CI/CD Pipelines, Microsoft Project/Trello/Jira, Legal Compliance, GitHub, and Claude.ai
item.description:
Headquarters: Humane World for Animals
URL: https://humaneworld.org

The general salary range for this full-time position is $80,000 – 115,000. Salary offers will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, skills, training and education.

 

Humane World for Animals, a global leader in animal advocacy and protection, is seeking a Web Developer, eCRM to support Digital Marketing and other departments by providing front-end, global web development solutions for fundraising, advocacy engagement, and other strategic priorities — incorporating AI-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous human oversight, quality, and security standards.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborates regularly with Digital Marketing, Brand and Visuals, and IS teams to discuss project requirements and makes technical recommendations. Writes efficient code and maintains custom donation forms, advocacy forms, other webpages, and email templates. Incorporates best practices for user experience, accessibility, page speed optimization, and GDPR compliance implementation. Adheres to global regulations and standards, regional data compliance, and security compliance;
  • Uses AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding assistants to accelerate coding, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation. Proactively identifies opportunities for AI-assisted and agent-built solutions and owns the ongoing maintenance, monitors their performance over time and updates or retires them as needed. Follows established guardrails and usage standards for AI tools and applies human-in-the-loop review to all AI-generated code and configurations, validating output for accuracy, security, accessibility, and brand/technical standards before deployment;
  • Follows quality assurance procedures and troubleshoots technical issues affecting donation forms, advocacy forms, webpages, and email templates in Engaging Networks. Works closely with vendor partners;
  • Works with the Information Security team to ensure that digital properties meet security standards, including managing script inventory, attestation, and other requirements for PCI compliance;
  • Collaborates with the testing team to gather testing requirements and implement new features to run A/B and multivariate tests on forms;
  • Creates and maintains clear and concise documentation of custom web development, support guides, and incident reports;
  • Performs other duties as assigned. 

 

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer programming, web development, or related field, or equivalent work experience required; 
  • A minimum of four (4) years of experience in front-end web development and developing custom websites required;
  • Demonstrated experience with Engaging Networks or other eCRMs;
  • Proficient in HTML5, Sass and CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, GitHub, Engaging Networks modules, Webpack, Node, npm, core AWS services, and Mailgun. Familiar with Segment or other CDPs;
  • Direct experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot;
  • Knowledge of best practices for responsive, mobile-first web design, UX, accessibility, page speed optimization, browser support, and GDPR compliance;
  • Familiar with cookie consent tools, preferably Iubenda, for configuring compliance settings;
  • Experience building interactive data visualizations that translate campaigns into compelling stories for supporters to increase engagement;
  • Excellent attention to detail when coding projects based on Adobe XD files or Figma;
  • Understanding of digital marketing strategies for US and international audiences;
  • Stays on top of AI trends in web development, including personalization and workflow automation, and their responsible application to fundraising and advocacy technology;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills;
  • Must be able to multi-task in a fast-paced, collaborative environment to deliver high quality work on deadline. Familiarity with Jira and Confluence a plus;
  • Data informed problem solver having experience with A/B testing platforms and Google Analytics;
  • Proactive and ability to work both independently and as an effective team member in a team environment;
  • Interest in animal protection issues preferred.

 

This is a full-time remote position based in the United States. Candidates must be able to accomodate Eastern Time hours, as needed. 

 

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, marital or parental status or protected veteran status.  EOE 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/humane-world-for-animals-web-designer-ecrm-1

item.title: Air Apps: Framer Website Designer

item.description:
Headquarters: Helsinki
URL: http://airapps.com

Framer Website Designer (Onsite – Presidio, San Francisco)

About Air Apps

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018 and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco, we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.

Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.

Join us on this journey to redefine resource management and change lives along the way.

  • This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.

The Role

As a Framer Website Designer, you’ll take ownership of designing and building high-performing, visually compelling websites using Framer. You’ll collaborate closely with our marketing, product, and engineering teams to create seamless web experiences that reflect our brand vision while meeting business and performance goals.

You’ll also work directly with SEO professionals, your closest collaborators, to ensure all pages are optimized for discoverability, loading speed, and accessibility. From landing pages to product microsites, your designs will directly influence how millions of users engage with Air Apps online.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build responsive, accessible, and engaging websites and landing pages using Framer.

  • Partner with SEO experts to ensure designs meet performance, accessibility, and search engine optimization standards.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders from brand, marketing, and product to align on business goals and messaging.

  • Develop modular components and templates for scalable site structures.

  • Maintain and evolve the visual identity of our web presence in line with Air Apps’ brand guidelines.

  • Monitor site analytics and user behavior to inform iterative improvements and A/B testing.

  • Stay up to date with web design trends, Framer updates, and best practices in site performance.

Requirements

  • Around 3–5+ years of experience designing and building websites with a strong emphasis on visual storytelling and UX.

  • Deep proficiency in Framer, with a strong portfolio of responsive web experiences or live projects.

  • Solid understanding of web design principles including layout, hierarchy, typography, and mobile-first design.

  • Familiarity with web performance best practices, SEO fundamentals, and accessibility standards (WCAG).

  • Ability to work collaboratively with SEO and marketing teams to align design with search and content strategies.

  • Experience maintaining or contributing to a design system.

  • Strong visual communication and prototyping skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience working on marketing sites for SaaS, tech, or AI-driven products.

  • Familiarity with HTML/CSS or understanding of how websites are developed under the hood.

What benefits do we offer?

  • Apple hardware ecosystem for work.

  • Annual Bonus

  • Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.

  • Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.

  • Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.

  • Childcare support.

  • Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.

  • Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.

  • Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.

  • Meals 100% free at the hub.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.

Application Disclaimer

At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/air-apps-framer-website-designer-1

Headquarters: Bosnia And Herzegovina
URL: http://wisevu.com

Description

Wisevu™, along with our sister agencies Homevu™ and charitymarketing.com ™, has been providing industry-leading digital marketing services to medical practices, home service companies, and charities for over 17 years. Our multi-industry focus and diverse marketing approach create a dynamic and engaging work environment, supported by cutting-edge tools and collaboration with a highly skilled and experienced team of professionals.

We are driven by a mission to harness our collective online marketing wisdom to help organizations that contribute to the betterment of our communities achieve their organizational objectives.

Learn more at wisevu.com.

Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple website development projects from kickoff through launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including WordPress developers, designers, SEO specialists, copywriters, and QA, to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Define project scope, priorities, timelines, deliverables, and resource allocation.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients by providing project updates, managing expectations, and resolving issues proactively.
  • Review deliverables before client presentation to ensure quality, functionality, SEO best practices, accessibility, and alignment with project requirements.
  • Identify project risks, remove blockers, and keep projects moving efficiently.


Requirements

Must-haves:

  • Professional-level English proficiency (C1 or higher).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Business, Management, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience managing WordPress website development projects within a digital marketing agency or web development agency.
  • Strong understanding of the WordPress website development lifecycle, including discovery, design, development, QA, launch, and post-launch support.
  • Experience managing multiple client projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, including developers, designers, SEO specialists, and content teams.
  • Experience using project management tools such as Asana or similar.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Hands-on experience with WordPress, including basic site configuration and content management.
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
  • Familiarity with website performance, Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, and accessibility best practices.
  • Experience working with website builders such as Elementor, Divi, or Gutenberg.
  • Project Management certification.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Work-timings:

  • Able to provide at least 7 hours of overlap with the 9 am-5 pm EST workday (Monday - Friday).


Benefits

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours.
  • Competitive salary, which will be negotiated during the interview based on competencies, skills, and experience.
  • Annual salary review.
  • Premium training programs and access to an internal knowledge base built across 17 years of hands-on experience.
  • Professional equipment budget.
  • Access to cutting-edge tools.
  • Long-term and stable working relationship.

Apply now and help us achieve exceptional digital marketing results—together!

We kindly ask that you provide us with your resume in English.
